goal: Reduce local, agent and CI testing cost without weakening risk-based verification.
global_constraints: Do not mutate or hide unrelated uncommitted work.
Keep temporary logs and profiles in .local/.
Use migrations in the final control run.
Do not enable parallel execution until file and contract tests are isolated.
Keep production password hashing and storage settings unchanged.
cross_cutting_acceptance: One canonical pytest execution path is used locally and in CI.
Fast test settings remove production hashing and disk media overhead.
Agent rules define budgets, fail-fast output and when CI owns the full run.
CI avoids duplicate coverage and contract validation.
Targeted, full and e2e verification results are recorded.
